<quote by="Announced by Laughlan, Master of Rings">To commission the construction of a Prosperous Counting House in Karsk. Self funded by Wolfs Hearth and Embers of Iversgaard. Costing 5 weirwood, 5 white granite, and 30 crowns.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in [[Karsk]] that increases the Virtue Fund as per the '''[[Forwards and Rewards]]''' wind of fortune
* Announcement by the [[Master of Rings]]

==Date==
* Spring 386YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 5 wains of weirwood
* 5 wains of white granite
* 30 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Karsk_Counting_House}}
==Outcome==
* Now that work is complete, the [[Rewarding|Virtue Fund]] receives 12 crowns each summit in donations from citizens of the territory to [[Karsk#The_Iron_Hearth|the Iron Hearth]]
